scenes.narrative_purpose: Introduce tofu as a very common everyday Japanese food and set a familiar household context before revealing the hidden issue.
scenes.main_visual: Warm Japanese home kitchen with an open refrigerator showing tofu packs clearly, and a dining table with tofu dishes like miso soup and hiyayakko, conveying everyday normal life
supporting_elements: elderly Japanese couple at dining table
soft morning sunlight through kitchen window
scenes.layout: 16:9 wide composition, refrigerator on left, dining table on right, clean balanced spacing with empty center for text overlay

scenes.narrative_purpose: Show a strong warning that even good intentions in eating tofu can harm health if done incorrectly, creating shock and attention.
scenes.main_visual: Split-screen composition: left side shows fresh healthy tofu in a bright kitchen, right side shows the same tofu turning into a warning symbol with subtle red caution overlay, representing negative health impact
supporting_elements: balance scale tilted toward warning side
scenes.layout: Left-right split composition with clear contrast, center divider glowing faint red, text placed at top center for visibility
scenes.mood: serious, cautionary, slightly dramatic but clean and educational

scenes.narrative_purpose: Explain the concept that tofu itself is neutral, and its health impact depends on how it is eaten, including seasoning habits like soy sauce usage.
scenes.main_visual: A clean infographic-style balance scale in the center: left side shows tofu labeled as healthy food, right side shows a warning symbol labeled as harmful impact, with soy sauce pouring from above shifting the balance
scenes.layout: Centered balance scale composition with symmetrical left-right visual balance, soy sauce flow diagonally from top corner
scenes.mood: educational, neutral but cautionary, clear and structured

scenes.narrative_purpose: Show that common cooking habits like making miso soup may unintentionally reduce tofu’s nutritional value, questioning everyday assumptions.
scenes.main_visual: Clean kitchen scene showing a pot of miso soup being prepared with tofu inside, while subtle glowing nutrient particles are shown visually drifting away from the tofu into the air and down the drain, representing nutrient loss
supporting_elements: tofu cubes in miso soup pot
soft glowing particle effects representing nutrients
scenes.layout: Kitchen scene left side with cooking pot, right side simplified infographic overlay showing nutrient flow escaping, central space reserved for text
scenes.mood: educational, slightly cautionary, clean and informative

scenes.narrative_purpose: Explain that tofu type and handling method (water tofu vs koya tofu) can change perceived nutritional value, using a clear comparison.
scenes.main_visual: Split supermarket shelf scene: left side shows fresh tofu in water pack being discarded with water drain symbol, right side shows koya tofu (brown dried tofu) highlighted as nutrient-rich with glowing effect, clean infographic comparison style
scenes.layout: Left-right split comparison layout with clear separation line, product shelves aligned horizontally, text placed top center
